cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault; first funding may use wallet-signed CreateAccount or a native Payment to avoid public-account precreation griefing. Connected-wallet support for both remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Official-doc research lists SDF, Tatum, Blockdaemon, Ankr, and QuickNode Horizon as candidates; docs now indicate Blockdaemon mainnet history retention is full history. No endpoints are provisioned or probed. The Stellar root network passphrase, actual operator independence, and quotas remain unverified; no 2-of-3 provider set is selected. Mara Junior completed two read-only Sonnet/Haiku reviews; independent review confirmed the uncredited-deposit and payout-retry evidence gaps are latent because no reachable XLM deposit or payout exists. The plan now records owner-bound recovery and intent-bound fresh replacement evidence. The key setter is guarded, correcting an earlier review concern. Open design, implementation, and release work remains. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved. Official Stellar AccountMerge result-code and account-reserve research now informs owner-bound recovery; merge has protocol blockers and is not guaranteed. The plan distinguishes spendable-residue Payment, terminal merge, and unsolicited-transfer accounting. No API or testnet proof exists. A read-only re-read on 2026-11-03 09:19 UTC returned the same live XRP values (Active; 128%/117%/~132.27%/7.5%; 0.2% fee; 1.5% base APR; $30,000 ceiling; Linear curve; min debt 0.1 icUSD), so the parity target is unchanged. It must be re-read again before any XLM activation.

cards.scope: Implement verified XLM deposits and borrowing
cards.evidenceText: Commit d45c8332 adds a dormant synchronous pending-deposit row and permanent custody attribution insertion with key/network, collision, expiry, and active-capacity guards. It accepts a caller-supplied freshly reserved vault ID and derived classic address; its focused tests and the deposit-evidence helper tests passed locally at daf1c440. No public open/confirm API, key derivation, Horizon outcall, or deposit credit is implemented. WP3 remains blocked; provider independence, live reserve/oracle freshness, atomic credit, and testnet/frontend integration remain open. No admission or deployment is proved. The plan now requires an explicit owner-bound recovery outcome for verified but uncredited funds before deposit confirmation becomes reachable; the current pure helper has no such lifecycle. The recovery design now requires owner-selected existing classic destination, durable exact intent, ambiguous-submit reconciliation, and a conditional terminal merge only after obligations clear. Official AccountMerge blockers are documented; implementation and testnet proof remain absent. A developer-only open-address source slice is now in the branch for an isolated test-build demo, with no credit or borrow. It is uncompiled, its test-build Candid is unverified, and it does not make the full deposit path reachable or admissible. On 2026-11-04 commit 85a7249e added the dormant synchronous credit step a confirm endpoint will call after evidence is verified, following confirm_xrp_deposit: it checks the pending row (active, unexpired, caller-owned, matching network and destination), the attribution, duplicate receipt identity across vaults, an already-funded vault, and credit bounds (non-zero, at least 1 XLM, no more than gross) before any change, then records an owned receipt and removes the pending row. cargo test --lib xlm_ passed 20/20 (16 existing plus 4 new, with no-mutation checks on every rejection). It adds no endpoint, outcall, Vault, mint or config change; XLM stays Frozen. Remaining: confirm endpoint with provider quorum and the funding-credit decision, and vault materialization from the receipt. Later on 2026-11-04 a test-build-only confirm_xlm_deposit (developer-only) was added: it reads transaction ledger, deposit list, account and reserve through three-provider Horizon quorum, takes only the transaction hash from the caller, requires exactly one quorum deposit to the custody address, runs the funding-credit decision, then atomically records the receipt and opens a zero-debt Vault. cargo test --lib xlm passed 22/22; test-build and production Wasm checks passed and the endpoint is compiled out of production. It fails closed because no reviewed Horizon provider config is stored. The async path has no PocketIC run yet; reserve-age, headroom and fee-budget values are new and await review. Follow-up: Horizon providers are compiled in per network like XRP; only horizon-testnet.stellar.org has in-repo evidence, mock origins fill slots 1-2 in test builds only, so other builds fail closed. Operations reads now attach the 10B-cycle budget (the 2B budget rejected every outcall). PocketIC xlm_confirm_pic passed 1/1 through confirm_xlm_deposit: disagreement leaves no vault, agreement opens one, replay is rejected; xlm_open_address_pic 1/1, lib xlm 22/22, lib stellar 143/143, production Wasm check clean. Provider tranche (2026-11-04, read-only probes): SDF, Ankr and Tatum testnet Horizon each returned 200 with the testnet passphrase for root, latest ledger, account, transaction and operations reads. SDF and Ankr are separately ingesting instances (different history range and metadata config) from different operators; Tatum keyless is limited to 5 requests/minute and returned 429 after a few calls, so under replicated outcalls it will usually be absent and live quorum needs SDF and Ankr together. Source now configures these three in every build, accepts fixed path prefixes, and adds vault owner/type/amount/debt assertions to the mocked PocketIC confirm test. These edits are unbuilt and untested pending a fresh compute allocation. Focused local batch at 32bed0e8 (19:16-19:19 PST, no edits): cargo test --lib stellar 145/145 and --lib xlm 22/22; test-endpoints Wasm rebuilt; PocketIC xlm_confirm_pic 1/1 with mocked responses keyed to the real provider URLs, asserting no vault on disagreement, one vault with correct owner, XLM type, 989,990,000 stroops and zero debt on success, and unchanged state on replay; production Wasm check clean.
